# Northwestern University
> Leading private research university serving students, faculty, staff, families, alumni, and researchers across academic, administrative, and news resources.

Northwestern University provides university-wide information on academics, administration, campus life, research priorities, student services, faculty resources, and institutional news. The main site also links to core systems such as CAESAR, Canvas, webmail, office directories, and the academic calendar.

## University Overview
- [Northwestern University Home](https://www.northwestern.edu/): Main university homepage with institutional overview, priorities, and featured news.
- [About Northwestern](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/index.html): Central overview of the university, its mission, campuses, and identity.
- [Northwestern Facts](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/facts.html): Key statistics and institutional facts about students, faculty, research, and campuses.
- [History & Traditions](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/history/index.html): University history, milestones, traditions, and notable campus symbols.
- [Vision, Mission & Priorities](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/mission-vision-priorities/index.html): Strategic direction and institutional priorities guiding Northwestern’s future.
- [University Leadership](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/university-leadership/index.html): Profiles and information about senior university leadership.
- [Board of Trustees](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/board-of-trustees/index.html): Governance information and membership of the university’s board.
- [Northwestern’s Nobel Laureate](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/nobel-laureate.html): Information on Northwestern’s Nobel laureate and related recognition.

## Strategic Priorities
- [Vision, Mission & Priorities](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/mission-vision-priorities/index.html): Overview of Northwestern’s institutional strategy and long-term priorities.
- [Advance the Biosciences](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/mission-vision-priorities/advance-the-biosciences.html): Strategic priority focused on biosciences research and collaboration.
- [Harness the Power of Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/mission-vision-priorities/harness-the-power-of-data-analytics-and-artificial-intelligence.html): Priority area centered on data science and AI innovation.
- [Foster Interdisciplinary Innovation Among Social Sciences and Global Studies](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/mission-vision-priorities/foster-interdisciplinary-innovation-among-social-sciences-and-global-studies.html): Priority supporting cross-disciplinary work in social sciences and global studies.

## Students
- [Students](https://www.northwestern.edu/students/index.html): Gateway to student services, academics, campus life, and essential resources.
- [Academic Calendar](https://planitpurple.northwestern.edu/calendar/academic_calendar/): Official academic calendar with key dates, terms, and deadlines.
- [CAESAR](https://caesar.northwestern.edu/): Student information system for registration, records, and academic administration.
- [Canvas](https://www.it.northwestern.edu/support/login/canvas.html): Access point for Northwestern’s learning management system.
- [Webmail](https://www.northwestern.edu/webmail/): University email access for students and other community members.

## Faculty & Staff
- [Faculty & Staff](https://www.northwestern.edu/faculty-and-staff/index.html): Central hub for faculty and staff resources, services, and announcements.
- [Faculty Accolades](https://www.northwestern.edu/faculty-accolades/): Recognition and highlights of faculty awards, honors, and achievements.
- [Office Directory](https://offices.northwestern.edu/): Directory of university offices, departments, and administrative units.
- [Canvas](https://www.it.northwestern.edu/support/login/canvas.html): Teaching and course access portal for instructors and staff.
- [Webmail](https://www.northwestern.edu/webmail/): University email access for faculty and staff accounts.

## Parents, Families & Alumni
- [Parents & Families](https://www.northwestern.edu/parents-and-families/index.html): Information and resources for families supporting Northwestern students.
- [Alumni](https://www.northwestern.edu/alumni/index.html): Alumni gateway for engagement, services, and university connections.
- [Academic Calendar](https://planitpurple.northwestern.edu/calendar/academic_calendar/): Important academic dates useful for families and alumni planning visits.
- [Northwestern University Home](https://www.northwestern.edu/): Main institutional entry point for broad university information.

## News & Media
- [Northwestern Now](https://news.northwestern.edu/): Official university news site covering research, campus, and community stories.
- [For Journalists](https://news.northwestern.edu/for-journalists): Media resources, contacts, and information for members of the press.
- [Media](https://news.northwestern.edu/for-journalists): Press-facing newsroom page linked from university navigation.
- [Northwestern University Home](https://www.northwestern.edu/): Homepage featuring top institutional announcements and news highlights.

## Directories & Core Services
- [Office Directory](https://offices.northwestern.edu/): Searchable directory of university offices and administrative contacts.
- [Webmail](https://www.northwestern.edu/webmail/): Login page for Northwestern email services.
- [CAESAR](https://caesar.northwestern.edu/): Administrative portal for enrollment, records, and student transactions.
- [Canvas](https://www.it.northwestern.edu/support/login/canvas.html): Login and support entry for the university’s LMS.
- [Academic Calendar](https://planitpurple.northwestern.edu/calendar/academic_calendar/): Central calendar for academic schedules and deadlines.

## Featured Institutional Resources
- [Northwestern Facts](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/facts.html): Concise institutional data useful for reference and reporting.
- [University Leadership](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/university-leadership/index.html): Leadership structure and executive administration information.
- [Board of Trustees](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/board-of-trustees/index.html): Governance details and trustee listings.
- [Faculty Accolades](https://www.northwestern.edu/faculty-accolades/): Faculty distinction and award highlights across the university.
- [History & Traditions](https://www.northwestern.edu/about/history/index.html): Background on Northwestern’s heritage and longstanding traditions.
